The wooden gunsmith has expanded their wares. All non-special guns can now be purchased with the "sage's shot" and "elemental ammunition" upgrades, and already purchased weapons can have the upgrades added for additional time and money.
Purchasing a weapon with one of the two upgrades adds an additional 75 gold to the cost, and purchasing with two adds a yet further 200 gold (so a fae'd wood palm pistol with both upgrades would cost a total of 350gp: 50 gold base cost, 25 gold for fae'd wood, 75 gold for the first upgrade, and 200 gold for the second upgrade).
Adding upgrades to a previously purchased weapon costs an additional 25 gold more than the normal upgrade cost and takes 8 hours per upgrade.
Ammunition with a specific essence quality can be purchased at the price of 50 gold for 5 shots.
**Sage's shot**
Your weapon has been enhanced and altered to rely on your awareness rather than speed. This firearm now uses Wisdom instead of Dexterity to determine its to hit bonus and damage bonus.
**Elemental Ammunition**
This firearm has been upgraded, and now can make use of the varying properties of essence in its shots. A shot fired from this weapon when loaded with essence now has a different effect based on the essence's type. If an essence has more than one quality, choose one quality when you load the gun. Types and effects are listed below:

**Acidic** shots deal acid damage instead of piercing.
When a **chaotic** shot is fired, roll a d12 (1-Slashing, 2-Bludgeoning, 3-Poison, 4-Acid, 5-Fire, 6-Cold, 7-Radiant, 8-Necrotic, 9-Lightning, 10-Thunder, 11-Force, 12-Psychic). The shot deals magical damage of the rolled damage type. 
**Cold** shots deal cold damage instead of piercing.
When loaded with **dimensional** shots, a gun can hold an additional 3 shots before it must be reloaded. 
**Fiendish** shots deal magical piercing damage instead of normal piercing damage.
**Fiery** shots deal fire damage instead of piercing.
**Forceful** shots deal force damage instead of piercing.
**Inert** shots ignore AC boosts from *shield*, other spells, and other spell-like effects.
**Lightning** shots deal lightning damage instead of piercing.
**Mercurial** shots function normally underwater.
**Necrotic** shots deal necrotic damage instead of piercing.
Once per turn when you hit with a **phantasmal** shot, you may make a perception check as a free action.
**Poisonous** shots deal poison damage instead of piercing.
**Psychic** shots deal psychic damage instead of piercing.
**Radiant** shots deal radiant damage instead of piercing.
Reloading a firearm entirely with **theurgic** shots may be done as a bonus action.
**Thundering** shots deal thunder damage instead of piercing.
A target hit by a **vital** shot restores half as much health when healing until the start of your next turn. 
The range of **void** shots are increased by 10 feet if fired from dim light, and by 20 feet if fired from darkness.
the range of **zephyrous** shots are increased by 15 feet if fired from a height, such as while under the effects of the *fly* spell or on an airship.
